# Anne Shirley & Paul Irving

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) — teacher and companion on visits · since v2  <sub>[v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P19](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0019), +3 more</sub>
- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Mentor of — [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) — teacher · since v2  <sub>[v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P24](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0024), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P35](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0035), +1 more</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) begins her first day teaching at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school, observing her new pupils and feeling a special connection with [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). After school, an eccentric parent, Mrs. Donnell, confronts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about how her children's names are pronounced and used. Returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares her experience with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), remaining determined to win over the sullen [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md).
>
> — v2 · V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P23](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0023)_

> In a detailed letter to her friend [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) describes her experiences and humorous anecdotes from teaching her pupils. She shares various amusing classroom incidents and transcripts of letters written by her students, concluding with a imaginative composition by her favorite pupil, [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md).
>
> — v2 · XI Facts and Fancies

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P9](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0009), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P26](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0026), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)_

> Suffering from a toothache and a frustrating day, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) mistakenly orders a pupil to throw a package into the school stove, causing an explosion of firecrackers. Later, when [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) plays a prank on her with a mouse, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) loses her temper and whips him. Though distraught over her loss of self-control, she discovers the next morning that the punishment earned Anthony's respect.
>
> — v2 · XII A Jonah Day

_Sources: [v2 XII A Jonah Day P18](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0018), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P19](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0019), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P50](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0050)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finishes the school year and walks toward the cemetery, joining [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) along the way as they discuss family, grief, and imagination. After placing flowers on Matthew's and Hester Gray's graves, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) meets Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and the two walk home together chatting about ideals, teaching mistakes, studies with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and the true meaning of friendship.
>
> — v2 · XV The Beginning of Vacation

_Sources: [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P0](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0000), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P2](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0002), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P26](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0026), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P45](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0045)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends a pleasant day taking the twins rowing with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), then visits [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) for tea and reassures him about his imaginative nature. Upon returning home, she helps [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) say his prayers and mend his jealous feelings. Later, she meets [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) near the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble), reflecting on how mature and handsome he has become.
>
> — v2 · XIX Just a Happy Day

_Sources: [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P1](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0001), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P15](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0015), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P37](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0037), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Miss Lavendar at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) on a wintry evening, where they share tea, make candy, and discuss Miss Lavendar's past romance with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). Miss Lavendar agrees to meet Stephen's son, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), and a month later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) brings [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) for a delightful visit.
>
> — v2 · XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance

_Sources: [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P9](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0009), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P15](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0015), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P26](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0026), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P29](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0029)_

> Following [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) Lynde's death, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) proposes that [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) can leave to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resigns from her teaching position, which causes great sorrow among her students and her friend [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), even as she prepares for her new journey.
>
> — v2 · XXVI Around the Bend

_Sources: [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034)_

> At [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) dinner, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) chatted with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), school pranks, and marriage until [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) laughed herself out to the cellar hatch. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) walked to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to visit Miss Lavendar and Charlotta the Fourth, enjoying lunch, playing with echoes, and gathering wild strawberries.
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P1](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0001), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P35](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0035)_

> While berry picking, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) confides in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about her worries over Miss Lavendar's melancholy mood and changed behavior. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) promises to come stay at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) during her vacation to help cheer Miss Lavendar up. Later, while having tea in the garden, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) talks with Miss Lavendar about her imaginary dream-boy before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) head home.
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P49](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0049), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P51](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0051), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P59](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0059)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Miss Lavendar at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) before returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where she meets Paul's father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). Stephen asks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to inquire if he may visit Miss Lavendar, leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to carry a message and help Miss Lavendar prepare for his arrival.
>
> — v2 · XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P17](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0017), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P35](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0035), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P57](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0057)_

> As preparations for Miss Lavendar's wedding get underway, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses the romantic turn of events with [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), Charlotta the Fourth, and a skeptical [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally discovers that [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) are in love, leading [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to visit [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to confide her engagement details to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).
>
> — v2 · XXIX Poetry and Prose

_Sources: [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P0](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0000), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P5](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0005), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P15](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0015)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) help Miss Lavendar and Charlotta the Fourth prepare for Miss Lavendar's wedding at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). The ceremony goes wonderfully as the sun breaks through the clouds, and the guests see off the newlyweds. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) waits with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) at the quiet house, where a moment of realization sparks a shift in how she perceives [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and her own maturity.
>
> — v2 · XXX A Wedding at the Stone House

_Sources: [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0030), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P33](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0033), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P40](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0040)_
